title: Laser Skin Revitalization in Ocala, FL | GLO Aesthetics
meta: Laser skin revitalization in Ocala, FL treats sun damage, fine lines and acne scars with Tetra CO2, CoolPeel or Motus, from $300. Book a laser consult.
answer: Laser skin revitalization is an FDA-cleared laser resurfacing treatment that smooths sun damage, fine lines, acne scars and uneven texture by triggering deep collagen remodeling. We match you to Tetra CO2, CoolPeel or Motus based on your goals and schedule. Sessions take 20–45 minutes, Tetra CO2 means 5–7 days of downtime, and results keep developing for 3–6 months.
treats_h2: What does laser skin revitalization treat?
treats_intro: Laser skin revitalization treats sun damage and age spots, fine lines and wrinkles, acne scarring, and uneven texture and pores by resurfacing damaged skin and rebuilding collagen underneath.
how_h2: How does laser skin revitalization work?
how: Our most powerful option, Tetra CO2, is a fractional CO2 laser. It creates tiny columns of controlled heat in the skin while leaving the surrounding skin untouched, which helps you heal faster. Your body replaces the treated skin with fresh skin and builds new collagen for 3–6 months. CoolPeel uses the same CO2 technology with brief, shallow pulses for less downtime, and the DEKA Motus laser facial is our gentlest, no-downtime option.
fit_h2: Is laser skin revitalization right for me?
good_fit: You have sun damage, age spots or uneven tone you'd like to fade
You're bothered by fine lines, deeper wrinkles or acne scarring
You want smoother texture and smaller-looking pores
You can plan around some downtime, or you'd like help choosing a lower-downtime laser
not_fit: You have an active cold sore, skin infection or open wound in the treatment area
You've recently taken isotretinoin (Accutane) — ask your provider about timing
Your main concern is loose or sagging skin — skin tightening with Everesse or Radiant Lift may fit better
expect_h2: What happens during a laser skin revitalization appointment?
expect_intro: Numbing cream goes on 30–45 minutes before treatment. The laser then treats your skin in a controlled pattern for 20–45 minutes. With Tetra CO2, expect 5–7 days of redness and peeling.

faq_add.q: How many laser skin revitalization sessions do I need?
faq_add.a: Many clients do 1–3 sessions spaced 4–6 weeks apart. The number depends on the laser you choose, how deep your concerns are and your goals. Your provider will recommend a plan at your consultation.

faq_add.q: What should I avoid after laser skin revitalization?
faq_add.a: Avoid sun exposure and wear sunscreen daily while your skin heals. Don't pick or peel flaking skin. Skip retinoids, exfoliants and harsh products until your provider says it's okay. Use the gentle cleanser and moisturizer they recommend.

faq_add.q: How long do laser skin revitalization results last?
faq_add.a: Results can be long-lasting. Collagen keeps rebuilding for 3–6 months after treatment. Your skin still ages and sees sun, though, so daily SPF and occasional maintenance sessions help you keep your results. Results vary from person to person.
